hero.headline: Built by the process it teaches.
The process is the product.
hero.subhead: Specs, not guesses. Scripts, not claims. Green, not hope.

mission.headline: A rehearsal in public, shipped by the process it teaches.
mission.body: Blueprint Lab is the practice run before the real rebuild. Every pixel on this page has a spec, a PR, and a green CI run behind it.

builder.label: For the builder
builder.title: One discipline, repeated forever.
builder.body: Spec. Plan. Tasks. Implement. Nine scripts. Green. Repeat.

process.label: For the process

value.headline: The process does the heavy lifting.
value.body: Nothing here is vibes. Every section links to the spec that built it.
